from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_bridge.py'
DISPATCHER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py'
PUBLISHER = ROOT / 'tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py'

def text(path):
    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

def test_bridge_accepts_python_evidence_check():
    value = text(BRIDGE)
    assert 'python_evidence' in value
    assert 'CHECK_{index}_INVALID_PATH' in value or 'INVALID_PATH' in value

def test_dispatcher_supports_successful_evidence_only_jobs():
    value = text(DISPATCHER)
    assert 'EDARSA_EVIDENCE_JSON=' in value
    assert 'EVIDENCE_READY' in value
    assert 'evidence_only_without_evidence' in value
    assert 'result["evidence"]' in value

def test_evidence_only_does_not_integrate_temp_audit_file():
    value = text(DISPATCHER)
    assert 'evidence_only = job.get("evidence_only") is True' in value
    assert 'elif not result["blockers"]:' in value
    assert 'create_commit(worktree, job_id, sorted(allowed_files))' in value

def test_publisher_exposes_successful_structured_evidence():
    value = text(PUBLISHER)
    assert 'STRUCTURED_EVIDENCE_CHECK_PASS' in value
    assert '"evidence",' in value
    assert '"work_completion": "COMPLETE"' in value
